text_block_list.text:
Finalizing plans with Nakayama Festa for 
the overseas expedition next year. 
Confirming departure dates, training 
locations, and other details—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Phew... Mind if I turn on the TV?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take a short break.
Yeah, let's take a short break.

text_block_list.text:
"Before we knew it, we had been deep in 
conversation for over three hours. Both of 
our heads must be thoroughly exhausted. I 
grab the remote and turn on the TV."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, boy, this is...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, this year's Comedy Grand Prix! 
Which duo will pull off a comeback from 
the repechage?!

It was a broadcast of the popular comedy 
contest that had become an annual 
tradition.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now, I wonder which number will make it to 
the finals this year...
choice_data_list: You like comedy?
Did you always like comedy?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No, not really. Just—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"The results of the repechage will be 
announced shortly! Be sure to make your 
predictions, everyone! The answer right 
after the commercial break!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Which combo number do you think will hit? 
We've got everything from 1 to 99 right 
here.

Nakayama Festa grins. To her, even making 
this prediction is just another fun 
"gamble."
choice_data_list:
I haven't even seen the routine, so I 
can't predict anything!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So it's all good, isn't it? That puts you 
and me on fair, equal ground.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tell you what... If your prediction comes 
true, I'll treat you to Christmas chicken.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"On the other hand, if I hit the mark, 
you're treating me to dinner. You're 
getting hungry about now too, right?"
choice_data_list: What if you both miss in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Stop worrying about getting it wrong and 
just pick already. The commercial break's 
almost over!
choice_data_list: Well then...

text_block_list.text:
Hurried by Nakayama Festa, I blurt out a 
number through my hazy mind. The result 
is—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Here, Christmas chicken for you.
choice_data_list: Well then, thank you for the food.

text_block_list.text:
Inside the bag Nakayama Festa handed over 
was the kind of fried chicken sold at 
convenience stores year-round.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, nice guess. To pull off a 
1-in-99 shot on the first try.
choice_data_list:
Maybe my senses were just heightened at 
the time

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, sounds great. Keep polishing it up 
like that for me.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... That's an awfully spirited 
response.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Did getting rewarded with chicken fire you 
up even more?
choice_data_list:
It takes intuition to read a race, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ............Haaahhhhh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"What's the point of tying absolutely 
everything to racing? You really ought to 
do something about that serious streak of 
yours."

And so, after enjoying some Christmas 
fried chicken, we headed back to the 
academy.

Hurried by Nakayama Festa, I blurt out a 
number through my hazy mind. The result 
is—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the oyster bar I looked up 
earlier was around here somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All that talk about France has completely 
put me in the mood for oysters.
choice_data_list:
I didn't realize you loved oysters that 
much.
I had no idea you loved oysters that much.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, they taste damn good too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's a fun treat where you can challenge 
yourself to see if you hit the jackpot the 
next day, right?
choice_data_list:
As for 'fun'... I don't think I can really 
relate.

text_block_list.text:
Just as Nakayama Festa connected oysters 
with France earlier, oysters are indeed a 
staple of French cuisine.

However, during the trip, the race must 
take priority over any battle with 
oysters. Even after arriving, oysters will 
have to wait.
choice_data_list: (...An expedition to France, huh)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. What's wrong? Did you realize you 
don't have enough cash on you to treat me?
choice_data_list:
No, I was just thinking about something 
else.

text_block_list.text:
While putting together the details of the 
French expedition, a thought crossed my 
mind.

It was an option to assign her a Trainer 
other than myself, just for this period.
choice_data_list:
Certain pairings and places have 
chemistry, don't they?

Certain pairings and places have 
chemistry, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa... what are you talking about 
all of a sudden? Did you get influenced by 
some TV show you just watched or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Yocchan...! You watching the TV? I 
won! I'm going to the finals!!

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
Just like you told me, I really did have 
talent...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"...That comedian formed a duo with their 
current partner after breaking up with the 
previous one last year, and their talent 
is finally starting to bloom."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
They say people have their own 
compatibilities, but depending on that, 
life can take a drastic turn as well—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, in life, there'll always be times 
when someone asks another to stand in for 
them, or finds themselves being asked.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The person who can bring out 100% of your 
partner's strength isn't necessarily 
always gonna be you."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...If that time ever comes for me, too, 
I'll do what needs to be done with all my 
heart."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, wouldn't it be heartbreaking 
for the one who entrusted it to you?
choice_data_list: In that case—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's no reason to run away.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You've still got a job to do, you know? 
Like feeding me all the oysters I can eat.
choice_data_list: Huh!? Of course, that's the plan, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... Is that so~? Pretty sure you're 
the one who tried to distract me by 
changing the subject in the first place, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go. Before you change your 
mind and say you won't treat me.
choice_data_list:
I'm not running away, I promise I'll treat 
you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. I'll make sure to keep a close 
eye on you until it's time to pay the 
bill.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (...I really won't let you get away.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Someone else might handle me better than 
you, but no one can bring out my full 
potential like you do.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Because you and I are birds of a 
feather.)
